title: Исход 38 — Exodus 38
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Жертвенник для всесожжений высотой три локтя был сделан из ___.
cases.translation: The altar of burnt offering, three cubits high, was made of acacia wood.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) takes the genitive → акации.

cases.translation: He overlaid the altar with bronze.
cases.explain: The material used to cover it (покрыл) is expressed by the instrumental → бронзой.

cases.sentence: Он сделал для него ___, бронзовую сетку.
cases.translation: He made for it a grating, a bronze network.
cases.explain: Решётку is the direct object of сделал (made); a feminine -а noun takes -у in the accusative → решётку.

cases.sentence: Он отлил бронзовые кольца для шестов на четырёх ___ бронзовой решётки.
cases.translation: He cast bronze rings for the poles on the four corners of the bronze grating.
cases.explain: The preposition на meaning "on" a location takes the prepositional → углах (prepositional plural).

cases.sentence: Он сделал бронзовый умывальник с основанием из ___ женщин.
cases.translation: He made the bronze basin with its base from the mirrors of the women.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) takes the genitive plural → зеркал.

cases.sentence: Веселил сделал всё, как повелел ___ Господь.
cases.translation: Bezalel made everything as the Lord had commanded Moses.
cases.explain: The dative marks the person commanded — the one to whom повелел is directed → Моисею.

cases.sentence: Южная сторона была отделена ___ скрученного льна.
cases.translation: The south side was set off with hangings of twined linen.
cases.explain: The means by which it was separated (отделена) is expressed by the instrumental → завесами (instrumental plural).

cases.sentence: Южная ___ была сто локтей в длину.
cases.translation: The south side was a hundred cubits long.
cases.explain: Сторона is the subject of была (was), so it takes the nominative → сторона.

reading.ru: Жертвенник для всесожжений высотой три локтя был сделан из акации.
reading.question: What was the altar of burnt offering made from, and how tall was it?
reading.explain: The altar of burnt offering, three cubits high, was made of acacia wood.

reading.ru: Из бронзы сделал всю его утварь, горшки, лопатки, крапельные чаши, вилки для мяса и противни.
reading.question: From what were all the altar's utensils made?
reading.explain: He made all the altar's utensils — pots, shovels, basins, forks, and fire pans — of bronze.

reading.ru: Он сделал бронзовый умывальник с бронзовым основанием из зеркал женщин, служащих при входе в шатер собрания.
reading.question: From what were the bronze basin and its base made?
options: From the mirrors of the ministering women
reading.correct: From the mirrors of the ministering women
reading.explain: He made the bronze basin and its base from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

reading.ru: Все завесы вокруг двора были из крученого льна.
reading.question: What were all the hangings around the court made of?
reading.explain: All the hangings around the court were made of twined linen.

reading.ru: Веселил сын Ури, внук Хура из рода Иуды, сделал все, как повелел Моисею Господь.
reading.question: Who made everything as the Lord commanded Moses?
reading.explain: Bezalel, son of Uri, grandson of Hur of the tribe of Judah, made everything as the Lord had commanded Moses.

reading.ru: Золото, принесенного в дар на работы в святилище, было 29 талантов, 730 шекелей по весу шекеля скинии.
reading.question: How much gold was given for the work of the sanctuary?
reading.explain: The gold offered for the work of the sanctuary came to 29 talents and 730 shekels by the sanctuary weight.
